name: GhostTabs
description: Headless tabs root provider. Manages controlled/uncontrolled selection, activation mode, and orientation for APG tab composites.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: Controlled selected tab value. Omit for uncontrolled mode.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial selected value when `modelValue` is omitted.

props.name: activationMode
props.description: Focus-driven (`automatic`) vs explicit activation (`manual`) tab selection.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Tab list orientation for arrow-key roving and `aria-orientation`.

props.name: dir
props.description: Explicit text direction for roving focus within the tab list.

exposed.name: element
exposed.description: Root element after mount; null before mount.
